resources.string: No workspace selected. Project memories are unavailable; global memories can still be viewed and created.

Delete “%1$s” (%2$s)? This cannot be undone. Memories with the same name in other scopes are not affected.
The workspace or execution environment changed. Reads and writes on this page have stopped to avoid using the wrong target. Reload to continue.
Invalid name. Use letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores, without paths or control characters.

This memory file no longer exists. Return to the list and refresh.
Another operation updated this memory. Nothing was deleted. Refresh and review the latest content before confirming again.
The memory directory or file contains a symbolic link or unsafe path. Check its storage location before continuing.
Unable to read or write memories. Check directory access permissions and try again.
